name: Hotel Voramar Benidorm
title: Hotel Voramar | Benidorm | Official website
description: The new Hotel Voramar is a modern and urban space in the heart of Benidorm, with a Roof Terrace, live music, and delicious gastronomic proposals for a unique stay in front of the sea. Official website.
paragraphs: Spend an unforgettable holiday in the chicest environment. The new, fully renovated Hotel Voramar takes the concept of “urban cool” to the beach. A fresh, quality, modern and Mediterranean environment, with classic reminiscences of the hotel’s origins.

An exceptional location in the heart of Benidorm. Of special note are its new spaces: the Cocktail Bar and the Roof Terrace, where the music, latest gastronomic experiences and views are bound to fascinate.

This 2023, at Hotel Voramar we want you to take part in our initiatives. That is why, throughout the year, we will have monthly promotions or we will carry out different initiatives where our goal is to make you participate in something different. We count on you!

La Mar Apartments has studios and apartments with a balcony, a well‑equipped kitchen, a full bathroom and a TV, and some with a terrace overlooking the sea. You will find us five minutes away from Benidorm’s old town, just a stone’s throw away from the beach. All the amenities in the best location for a unique seaside holiday with friends or family.
Comfortable, well-lit rooms; most of them face the exterior and have a balcony. If you’re looking for a quieter space, you can book a room facing our inner courtyard.
headings: Check in online and save time!
